camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLivePullStreamInfoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --SourceUrl 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000' --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Updates the configuration of live stream pulling, including the addresses of the origin server, start time, and end time
description_zh: 更新直播拉流配置信息，包括源站地址、开始时间和结束时间
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --source-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePullStreamInfoConfig

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain used as the streamer's stream domain.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain is a live streaming domain and that the user calling this operation has the permission to operate on the specified domain
parameters.help_zh:
您的拉流域名为用户的主播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The full URL of the origin server where the live stream resides. You can specify multiple origin URLs separated by semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh: 用户的直播流所在的源站完整url。多个源站可以填多个地址，用英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream pulling. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of stream pulling. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内，且EndTime超过当前时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
